Placement.description: Where the server suggests the client put a view.

Scope.description: A named group of key bindings, e.g. `common` or `status`.

ViewMode.description: Whether the client may edit the view or only display it.

Viewport.description: The client's text area, needed to lay out multi-column views.

description: Everything a client needs to create the buffer for a view.

kind.description:
The wire name; schemars models it as an arbitrary string because `ViewKind`
has custom serde.

viewport.description: keep-for: TASKS §3.2 records viewport in the descriptor; clients may use it when creating the view.

title: ViewDescriptor
